name: Sylvain Goes on A Date
source:
In this Everyone Lives AU where Glenn is alive and Miklan is just a shut-in incel, Sylvain is on his first date with a man, and it's not just any man, it's his childhood friend, Felix. Can Sylvain prove himself to be the right man for his new soon-to-be-lover or will he just break his heart like he has with his many previous dates?

[From [url=https://heian.itch.io/sgod]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个所有人都活着的平行世界里，古廉尚在人世，迈克朗也只是个愤世嫉俗的单身宅男。希尔凡即将第一次与男人约会，而对方并非别人，正是青梅竹马菲力克斯。希尔凡能否证明，自己是这位准恋人的理想伴侣？还是会像对待过去的许多约会对象那样，再次伤透对方的心？

[摘自[url=https://heian.itch.io/sgod]itch.io[/url]]
